items.title: XRP Price Under Pressure: Spot Selling Overwhelms ETF Demand
items.summary: XRP price fell 8.5% to $1.46 despite $18.04M in ETF inflows, as $4.576B in spot volume overwhelmed regulated fund demand in the session.

items.title: OpenZeppelin Integrates with TRON to Bring Its Security Standard to the Network
items.summary: LONDON, UK, September 24, 2026 – OpenZeppelin, the security standard for onchain finance and secure smart contract development, today announced that its smart contract libraries and secure development suite are now available for the TRON network. The integration gives developers building on TRON access to OpenZeppelin’s widely used security-focused development framework, adapted specifically for the TRON network. items.title: Base Activity Climbs To 7.5 Million Transactions In A Day
items.summary: TL;DR Base network activity reached roughly 7.5 million transactions over a single day in the validated September 22 data. The count includes all recorded transactions, including low-value and automated activity. High transaction count is a usage metric, not proof of equivalent economic value. Base has pushed daily transaction activity to roughly 7.5 million, adding another scale milestone for Coinbase’s Ethereum Layer 2 ecosystem. items.title: Who is Ronald Spektor? New York Coinbase Scam Mastermind That Stole $15.9M
items.summary: A Coinbase scam stole roughly $15.944 million from about 100 users before Ronald Spektor was sentenced to four to 12 years in prison in New York.
